item.title: [Due in 4 days] Teams consolidates GitHub Notifications and GitHub Copilot into one GitHub app; the legacy app is deprecated by 16 November 2026
item.description:
A new third-party app identity replaces the old one, so an app permission policy that allowed the legacy GitHub app does not automatically cover the new one, and its consent must be reviewed like any new app.

Teams · deadline 2026-11-16 · Check the Teams app permission policies and the Entra consent granted to the new GitHub app before 16 November, and remove the legacy app from allow lists afterwards.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1546409 Microsoft Teams: Retirement of off-network invitations to Teams Free
item.description:
Microsoft Teams will retire off-network invitations for Teams Free accounts starting December 2026. Users can no longer invite external people via email or chat links to create Teams Free accounts. Existing Teams Free collaboration and federation remain unchanged. No admin action is needed, but user guidance should be updated.

item.description:
Microsoft Teams will retire the invitation flow that allows work or school users to invite people who cannot be found in Teams to create a Teams Free account and join a chat.

Next: early Dec 2026.

item.title: [New] Teams retires off-network email and link invitations that onboard outsiders to Teams Free in December; federation with existing Teams Free users stays
item.description:
One path by which users pulled unmanaged consumer accounts into chats goes away; chats with existing Teams Free accounts remain governed only by external-access policy.

Teams · Update helpdesk guidance before 6 December; review the external-access policy for Teams Free (consumer) accounts while the topic is open.

item.description:
Microsoft Teams will introduce a Workflows app template to automatically add users to channels when they are added to a team tag. This optional feature, rolling out worldwide in mid-December 2026, helps streamline access for location- or project-based groups without default changes.

item.title: [Message Center] MC1540349 Microsoft Teams: Decline incoming mobile calls with a message
item.description:
Microsoft Teams mobile users will soon be able to decline incoming calls with a predefined or custom message sent via Teams chat. This feature, rolling out worldwide in December 2026, enhances communication without answering calls. It applies only to Teams-to-Teams calls with available chat and requires no admin action.
